correctness.rationale: For every a,b>=1, count-chain next states are independent binomial/monochrome given current majority signs. The two-step sign channel fixes strict signs and preserves a tie with probability q_a q_b<=1/4; two eventual strict signs are independent fair resolutions of initial ties. It follows there are just two monochromatic fixed points and one opposing period-two class. Conditioning one update by pure/mixed/tied probabilities yields the three given PGF equations and X,Y,Z expectations. G(q_a,q_b) is increasing; decreasing even central-binomial probabilities reduce global sharp 79/27 to nine explicit finite even pairs, attained only K_(2,6) with both parts tied. Fresh exact rational Bellman checks for 36 size pairs verified transient equations; those finite checks supplement the all-size argument.
